Five comments

Two Trees

A tune from Brian Finnegan’s album ‘Hunger of the Skin’. I wasn’t quite sure of the tune type but I figured it was a kind of slow reel, so I have categorized it as a Strathspey but please correct me if I am wrong. I also apologize for the strange octave jumps between parts, I wanted limit the number of notes off the stave as much as possible. I will add a setting a tone lower in G major, to play on D whistles.

↳ Posted by benóKoroit on March 25th, 2021.

Re: Two Trees

Nice tune. The recording is in A, but both keys are fun to play. It does have an interesting canter. Maybe a fast air?

↳ Posted by Tom Purvis on March 25th, 2021.

Re: Two Trees

Thanks Tom, yeah a fast air is what I am thinking (especially the A part), but there is no category for Airs as tune type is based on time signature, not feel.

↳ Posted by benóKoroit on March 26th, 2021.
